text: Rabobank is an international cooperative bank with Dutch origins; it is a bank without shareholders, with more than 2.3 million members among its customers in the Netherlands.
short: Rabobank is a cooperative bank without shareholders, owned by its members.

source.name: Rabobank: Rabobank at a glance (About us)
source.quote: Being a cooperative bank sets us apart. We are a bank without shareholders, but with members and client councils. More than 2.3 million of our customers in the Netherlands are already members.
source.note: Archived copy of Rabobank's 'Rabobank at a glance' page (rabobank.com was unreachable from our network on 2026-10-03). The same page opens with: 'Rabobank is an international cooperative bank with Dutch origins.'
